name: accounts_share_network
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accounts_share_network(p_a uuid, p_b uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_a is null or p_b is null or p_a = p_b then return false; end if;
  return exists (select 1 from auth.sessions a join auth.sessions b on b.ip = a.ip
                  where a.user_id = p_a and b.user_id = p_b and a.ip is not null);
exception when undefined_table or undefined_column or insufficient_privilege then
  return false;   -- no signal available: never block on a signal we cannot read
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.block_client_writes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  -- `role` is the PostgREST-selected role; SECURITY DEFINER does not change it,
  -- service_role / postgres / migrations report something else.
  if coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated')
     and coalesce(current_setting('app.trusted_order_write', true), 'false') <> 'true' then
    raise exception 'Table % is written by the payment system only', tg_table_name
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_payment_jobs(p_kind text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 40)
 RETURNS TABLE(target_id text, lease_id uuid, attempts integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_kind not in ('reports','refunds','consume','reconcile','compensate','events')
    or p_limit<1 or p_limit>40 then raise exception 'invalid job claim'; end if;
  return query with due as (
    select j.kind,j.target_id from public.payment_jobs j
    where j.kind=p_kind and j.next_attempt_at<=now()
      and (j.status='pending' or (j.status='leased' and j.lease_until<now()))
    order by j.deadline_at,j.created_at,j.target_id
    for update skip locked limit p_limit
  ), claimed as (
    update public.payment_jobs j set status='leased',lease_id=gen_random_uuid(),
      lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',attempts=j.attempts+1
    from due d where j.kind=d.kind and j.target_id=d.target_id
    returning j.target_id,j.lease_id,j.attempts
  ) select c.target_id,c.lease_id,c.attempts from claimed c;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_play_payment_jobs(p_kind text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id text, lease_id uuid, attempts integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_kind not in ('consume','reconcile') or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 20 then
    raise exception 'invalid Play job claim';
  end if;
  return query with due as (
    select j.kind,j.order_id from public.play_payment_jobs j
    where j.kind=p_kind and j.next_attempt_at<=now()
      and (j.status='pending' or (j.status='leased' and j.lease_until<now()))
    order by j.next_attempt_at,j.created_at,j.order_id
    for update skip locked limit p_limit
  ), claimed as (
    update public.play_payment_jobs j set status='leased',lease_id=gen_random_uuid(),
      lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',attempts=j.attempts+1,updated_at=now()
    from due d where j.kind=d.kind and j.order_id=d.order_id
    returning j.order_id,j.lease_id,j.attempts
  ) select c.order_id,c.lease_id,c.attempts from claimed c;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.content_is_published(p_course_id text, p_year_id text, p_subject_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_chapter_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    exists (select 1 from public.courses co where co.id = p_course_id and co.active)
    and (p_year_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.years y
      where y.id = p_year_id and y.course_id = p_course_id and y.active
    ))
    and (p_subject_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.subjects s
      where s.id = p_subject_id and s.course_id = p_course_id and s.year_id = p_year_id and s.active
    ))
    and (p_chapter_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.chapters c
      join public.subjects s on s.id = c.subject_id and s.active
        and s.course_id = p_course_id and s.year_id = p_year_id
      where c.id = p_chapter_id and c.course_id = p_course_id and c.year_id = p_year_id and c.active
        and (p_subject_id is null or c.subject_id = p_subject_id)
    ));
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_payment_jobs()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'reports',o.id,coalesce(o.ucb_transaction_time,o.payment_provider_time,o.payment_completed_at,o.created_at)+interval '24 hours'
  from public.orders o where o.external_transaction_token is not null
    and o.external_report_status in ('pending','failed')
    and (o.ucb_transaction_time is not null or o.status in ('paid','refunded'))
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do update set deadline_at=excluded.deadline_at;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'refunds',r.refund_id,r.refund_time+interval '24 hours'
  from public.ucb_external_refunds r where r.status in ('pending','failed','processing')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'consume',o.id,coalesce(o.payment_completed_at,o.created_at)+interval '24 hours'
  from public.orders o where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid'
    and o.play_consumption_status in ('pending','failed')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'reconcile',o.id,coalesce(o.play_last_checked_at,o.created_at)+interval '2 hours'
  from public.orders o where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token is not null
    and (o.play_last_checked_at is null or o.play_last_checked_at<now()-interval '2 hours')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do update set status='pending', next_attempt_at=now(),
    deadline_at=excluded.deadline_at, attempts=0, lease_id=null, lease_until=null
    where public.payment_jobs.status='done';
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'compensate',c.payment_id,c.created_at+interval '24 hours'
  from public.payment_compensations c where c.status in ('pending','processing')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  -- Captures survive an Edge/SQL outage even if no webhook is delivered again.
  -- Reuse the existing events schedule; these targets cannot collide with provider event IDs.
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'events','capture:' || c.payment_id,c.received_at+interval '24 hours'
  from public.payment_captures c where c.status='captured'
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'events',e.event_id,e.received_at+interval '24 hours'
  from public.provider_events e where e.status='pending' and e.payment_id is not null
    and (e.event_type in ('payment.captured','payment.authorized') or
      (exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.razorpay_payment_id=e.payment_id)
    and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created','payment.dispute.under_review',
      'payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.won','payment.dispute.lost','payment.dispute.closed')))
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
end $function$

name: enqueue_play_payment_jobs
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_play_payment_jobs()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.play_payment_jobs(kind,order_id)
  select 'consume',o.id from public.orders o
  where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token is not null
    and o.play_consumption_status in ('pending','failed')
  on conflict do nothing;

  insert into public.play_payment_jobs(kind,order_id)
  select 'reconcile',o.id from public.orders o
  where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token is not null
    and (o.play_last_checked_at is null or o.play_last_checked_at < now()-interval '2 hours')
  on conflict (kind,order_id) do update set status='pending',attempts=0,
    next_attempt_at=now(),lease_id=null,lease_until=null,last_error=null,updated_at=now()
  where public.play_payment_jobs.status='done';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_referral_list()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, friend_name text, joined_at timestamp with time zone, status text, amount numeric, available_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    r.id,
    case
      when nullif(trim(coalesce(p.name, '')), '') is null then 'A friend'
      else initcap(split_part(trim(p.name), ' ', 1))
           || case when array_length(regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.name), '\s+'), 1) > 1
                   then ' ' || upper(left((regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.name), '\s+'))
                                          [array_length(regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.name), '\s+'), 1)], 1)) || '.'
                   else '' end
    end as friend_name,
    r.created_at as joined_at,
    case
      when r.status = 'rejected' or l.status = 'cancelled' or rev.id is not null then 'cancelled'
      when l.id is null then 'joined'
      when l.status = 'available' or l.available_at <= now() then 'credited'
      else 'purchased_pending'
    end as status,
    l.amount,
    case when l.status = 'pending' then l.available_at end as available_at
  from public.referrals r
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = r.referred_id
  left join public.wallet_ledger l
         on l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward' and l.entry_type = 'credit'
  left join public.wallet_ledger rev
         on rev.reverses_id = l.id and rev.entry_type = 'reversal'
  where r.referrer_id = auth.uid()
  order by r.created_at desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_quiz_tests(p_subject_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_test_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', q.id, 'title', q.title, 'subject_id', q.subject_id,
    'year_id', q.year_id, 'course_id', q.course_id, 'order', q."order",
    'active', q.active, 'question_revision', q.question_revision,
    'subjects', jsonb_build_object('title', s.title),
    'years', jsonb_build_object('title', y.title),
    'questions', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'question', item.value->'question', 'options', item.value->'options'
      ) order by item.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(q.questions) = 'array'
        then q.questions else '[]'::jsonb end)
        with ordinality as item(value, ordinality)
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from public.quiz_tests q
  join public.subjects s on s.id = q.subject_id
  join public.years y on y.id = q.year_id
  where (p_subject_id is not null or p_test_id is not null)
    and (p_subject_id is null or q.subject_id = p_subject_id)
    and (p_test_id is null or q.id = p_test_id)
    and q.active
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = auth.uid() and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and public.content_is_published(q.course_id, q.year_id, q.subject_id)
    and public.has_content_access(q.course_id, q.year_id)
  order by q."order", q.id;
$function$

name: guard_purchase_success_ownership
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_purchase_success_ownership()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status <> 'success' then return new; end if;

  -- Metadata writes on existing ownership (including the historical duplicate)
  -- are not a new grant. Refund/reversal transitions never enter this branch.
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    if old.status = 'success'
       and new.user_id is not distinct from old.user_id
       and new.product_id is not distinct from old.product_id then
      return new;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- Legacy purchases can lack product/user identities. Keep their established
  -- scope-based access/restoration semantics; never infer a product from scope.
  -- All current verified settlements supply both keys.
  if new.user_id is null or new.product_id is null then return new; end if;

  -- A transaction-snapshot reader could miss a grant committed while waiting
  -- for the lock. Fail closed rather than accept stale REPEATABLE READ data.
  if current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' then
    raise exception 'Purchase ownership grant requires read committed isolation'
      using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  -- Same lock namespace/order as create, settle, refund and dispute routines.
  -- This VOLATILE trigger's SELECT takes a fresh READ COMMITTED snapshot after
  -- acquiring the lock, including when another transaction just committed.
  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended('wallet:' || new.user_id::text, 0));
  if exists (
    select 1 from public.purchases p
    where p.user_id = new.user_id and p.product_id = new.product_id
      and p.status = 'success'
      and (tg_op = 'INSERT' or p.id is distinct from old.id)
      -- Same-order insert replays cannot add a row: the unchanged unique
      -- order index enforces that even under concurrent ON CONFLICT writes.
      -- Keep this check AFTER the lock, so concurrent replays see the winner.
      and (tg_op <> 'INSERT' or new.order_id is null
           or p.order_id is distinct from new.order_id)
  ) then
    -- No silent conversion, compensation, deletion or historical repair here.
    -- The caller's complete transaction rolls back on a conflicting grant.
    raise exception 'Successful purchase ownership already exists'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

name: guard_razorpay_order_transition
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_razorpay_order_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.provider <> 'razorpay' or new.status is not distinct from old.status then
    return new;
  end if;

  -- UPDATE holds the order row lock. A writer waiting behind settlement sees
  -- the committed paid version, including under READ COMMITTED rechecking.
  -- No role/admin bypass: privileged error handlers must obey this too.
  if (old.status = 'refunded' and new.status <> 'refunded')
     or (old.status = 'paid' and new.status not in ('paid', 'refunded'))
     or (new.status in ('created', 'pending', 'failed', 'cancelled') and exists (
       select 1 from public.payment_captures c
       where c.razorpay_order_id = old.razorpay_order_id
     )) then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order transition conflicts with captured or terminal state'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  -- Unpaid failures can still settle later through the existing verified,
  -- atomic service-only settlement RPC. Full refunds remain paid -> refunded.
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_content_access(p_course_id text, p_year_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.am_i_admin()
    or (public.content_is_published(p_course_id, p_year_id) and (exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = auth.uid()
        and pr.course_id = p_course_id
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.purchases pu
      left join public.chapters ch on pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.id = pu.chapter_id
      left join public.subjects sb on pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.id = pu.subject_id
      where pu.user_id = auth.uid()
        and pu.status = 'success'
        and pu.course_id = p_course_id
        and (
          p_year_id is null
          or (pu.scope = 'year' and pu.year_id = p_year_id)
          or (pu.scope = 'bundle' and p_year_id = any(pu.year_ids))
          or (pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.year_id = p_year_id)
          or (pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.year_id = p_year_id)
        )
    )));
$function$

name: has_prior_purchase_identity
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_prior_purchase_identity(p_uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (

      from public.profiles p

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_phone(input text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case
    when input is null or btrim(input) = '' then null
    when regexp_replace(btrim(input), '[[:space:]().-]', '', 'g') ~ '^00[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
      then '+' || substr(regexp_replace(btrim(input), '[[:space:]().-]', '', 'g'), 3)
    when regexp_replace(btrim(input), '[[:space:]().-]', '', 'g') ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
      then regexp_replace(btrim(input), '[[:space:]().-]', '', 'g')
    else null
  end;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_reserve_first_discount()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.referral_discount>0 and new.referral_id is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || new.user_id::text,0));
    insert into public.first_discount_reservations(user_id,referral_id,order_id)
    values(new.user_id,new.referral_id,new.id)
    on conflict(user_id) do update set referral_id=excluded.referral_id,
      order_id=excluded.order_id,created_at=now()
    where exists(select 1 from public.orders o
      where o.id=first_discount_reservations.order_id
        and (o.status in ('failed','cancelled') or o.expires_at<=now()
          or (o.status='paid' and exists(select 1 from public.payment_captures c
            where c.order_id=o.id and c.status in ('compensation_pending','compensated','reversed')))))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.purchases p
        where p.user_id=new.user_id and p.status='success')
      and not exists(select 1 from public.referrals r where r.referred_id=new.user_id
        and (r.discount_order_id is not null or r.first_order_id is not null));
    if not exists(select 1 from public.first_discount_reservations
      where user_id=new.user_id and order_id=new.id) then
      new.amount:=new.amount+new.referral_discount;
      new.referral_discount:=0;
      new.referral_id:=null;
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.play_notes_product_eligible(p products)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.active and p.price > 0 and p.course_id is not null
    and ((p.scope in ('chapter','subject','year') and p.product_type='notes')
      or (p.scope='bundle' and p.product_type='notes_bundle'
        and cardinality(p.year_ids) between 2 and 3))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.notes n join public.chapters c on c.id=n.chapter_id
        join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id join public.years y on y.id=s.year_id
      where n.active and not n.is_free_preview and nullif(btrim(n.pdf_url),'') is not null
        and c.active and s.active and y.active
        and c.course_id=p.course_id and s.course_id=p.course_id and y.course_id=p.course_id
        and ((p.scope='chapter' and c.id=p.chapter_id)
          or (p.scope='subject' and c.subject_id=p.subject_id)
          or (p.scope='year' and c.year_id=p.year_id)
          or (p.scope='bundle' and c.year_id=any(p.year_ids)))
    )
    and (p.scope<>'bundle' or (
      select count(distinct c.year_id) from public.notes n
        join public.chapters c on c.id=n.chapter_id
        join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id join public.years y on y.id=s.year_id
      where n.active and not n.is_free_preview and nullif(btrim(n.pdf_url),'') is not null
        and c.active and s.active and y.active
        and c.course_id=p.course_id and s.course_id=p.course_id and y.course_id=p.course_id
        and c.year_id=any(p.year_ids)
    )=cardinality(p.year_ids));
$function$

name: razorpay_entitlement_committed
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(p_order_id text, p_payment_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.orders o
    join public.payments m on m.order_id=o.id
    join public.purchases p on p.order_id=o.id
    where o.id=p_order_id and p_payment_id is not null and p_payment_id<>''
      and o.provider='razorpay' and o.status='paid'
      and o.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id
      and o.razorpay_order_id is not null and o.razorpay_order_id<>''
      and o.user_id is not null and o.product_id is not null
      and o.amount>0 and o.course_id is not null
      and o.scope in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle')
      and case o.scope
        when 'chapter' then o.chapter_id is not null
        when 'subject' then o.subject_id is not null
        when 'year' then o.year_id is not null
        when 'bundle' then coalesce(cardinality(o.year_ids),0)>0
          and array_position(o.year_ids,null) is null
        else false end
      and m.provider='razorpay' and m.status='success'
      and m.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id and m.razorpay_order_id=o.razorpay_order_id
      and m.user_id=o.user_id and m.product_id=o.product_id and m.amount=o.amount
      and p.status='success' and p.user_id=o.user_id
      and p.product_id=o.product_id and p.amount=o.amount
      and p.razorpay_order_id=o.razorpay_order_id
      and row(p.scope,p.chapter_id,p.subject_id,p.year_id,p.year_ids,p.course_id)
        is not distinct from row(o.scope,o.chapter_id,o.subject_id,o.year_id,o.year_ids,o.course_id)
      -- Absence is allowed for historical purchases. An existing capture must
      -- match exactly and must not be awaiting or have completed reversal.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.payment_captures c
        where c.payment_id=p_payment_id and (
          c.order_id is distinct from o.id or c.razorpay_order_id is distinct from o.razorpay_order_id
          or c.amount_paise is distinct from round(o.amount*100)::bigint
          or c.status not in ('captured','granted')))
      -- Even parked compensation is unresolved; no compensation state grants.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.payment_compensations c where c.payment_id=p_payment_id)
      -- C recovery classifies provider facts before linking/settlement. A
      -- verified partial refund or won dispute may still await inbox application
      -- when the exact purchase transaction checks this proof. Unclassified,
      -- blocking and parked reversals continue to deny commitment.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.provider_events e
        where e.payment_id=p_payment_id and e.status in ('pending','parked')
          and (e.status='parked' or e.blocks_entitlement is distinct from false)
          and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created',
            'payment.dispute.under_review','payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.lost'))
  );
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ids uuid[];
  n integer;
begin
  -- Called from get_my_wallet() under the student's role: tell the
  -- block_client_writes backstop this write is ours (transaction-local).
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);

  -- Anti-farming: a credit whose referrer and friend have logged in from the same IP address is
  -- HELD for an admin (never granted automatically, never denied automatically: classmates on the
  -- same Wi-Fi or mobile network share an IP too). One flag per friend order; once an admin resolves
  -- it (admin_resolve_order_flag) the credit releases, or they reject the referral (admin_reject_referral).
  insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
  select l.order_id, l.user_id, 'referral_shared_network', 0, 0,
         jsonb_build_object(
           'referrer_id', l.user_id, 'friend_id', o.user_id, 'credit_ledger_id', l.id, 'credit_amount', l.amount,
           'signal', 'the two accounts have logged in from the same IP address',
           'caveat', 'college / hostel Wi-Fi and mobile-carrier networks share one IP between many people, so this can be two genuine classmates',
           'recommended_action',
             'Decide whether these are two accounts of the same person. If they are NOT, resolve this flag and the credit releases on the next run. If they ARE, reject the referral (admin_reject_referral) - that cancels the credit.')
    from public.wallet_ledger l
    join public.orders o on o.id = l.order_id
   where l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.source = 'referral_reward' and l.status = 'pending'
     and l.available_at <= now() and l.user_id is not null and o.user_id is not null
     and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)
     and public.accounts_share_network(l.user_id, o.user_id)
  on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;

  with due as (
    update public.wallet_ledger l
       set status = 'available'
     where l.entry_type = 'credit'
       and l.status = 'pending'
       and l.available_at <= now()
       and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)
       -- a credit earned by a payment that is being disputed stays held
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.order_id = l.order_id and pu.status = 'disputed')
       -- ... nor while a shared-network review is open
       and not exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags f
                        where f.order_id = l.order_id and f.reason = 'referral_shared_network' and f.resolved_at is null)
    returning l.id, l.referral_id
  )
  select array_agg(id), count(*) into v_ids, n from due;

  update public.referrals r
     set status = 'rewarded', rewarded_at = now()
   where r.status = 'qualified'
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.wallet_ledger l
        where l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward'
          and l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.status = 'available'
     );

  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
  return coalesce(n, 0);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_can_access_note(p_user uuid, p_note_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.notes n
      join public.chapters c on c.id = n.chapter_id
      where n.id = p_note_id and n.active
        and public.content_is_published(n.course_id, n.year_id, c.subject_id, n.chapter_id)
        and (
          (n.is_free_preview and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
            where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = n.course_id))
          or (not public.admin_mfa_required()
            and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user))
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.purchases p
            where p.user_id = p_user and p.status = 'success'
              and p.course_id = c.course_id
              and ((p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)
                or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)
                or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)
                or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any(p.year_ids)))
          )
        )
    );
$function$

      and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)

        where n.id = p_note_id and n.active

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_can_access_video(p_user uuid, p_video_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.videos v where v.id = p_video_id and v.active
        and public.content_is_published(v.course_id, v.year_id, v.subject_id)
        and (
          exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
            where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = v.course_id)
          or (not public.admin_mfa_required()
            and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user))
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.purchases pu
            left join public.chapters ch on pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.id = pu.chapter_id
            left join public.subjects sb on pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.id = pu.subject_id
            where pu.user_id = p_user and pu.status = 'success' and pu.course_id = v.course_id
              and ((pu.scope = 'year' and pu.year_id = v.year_id)
                or (pu.scope = 'bundle' and v.year_id = any(pu.year_ids))
                or (pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.year_id = v.year_id)
                or (pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.year_id = v.year_id))
          )
        )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_owns_chapter(p_chapter_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.am_i_admin()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.chapters c
      join public.purchases p
        on p.user_id = auth.uid()
        and p.status = 'success'
        and p.course_id = c.course_id
      where c.id = p_chapter_id
        and (
          (p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)
          or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)
          or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)
          or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any(p.year_ids))
        )
    );
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wallet_balance_of(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(available numeric, pending numeric, total_earned numeric, next_available_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    greatest(0,
      coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'available'
                                     and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())), 0)
      - coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type in ('debit', 'reversal') and status = 'available'), 0)
    )::numeric(10, 2) as available,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'pending'), 0)::numeric(10, 2) as pending,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status in ('pending', 'available')
                                   and source = 'referral_reward'), 0)::numeric(10, 2) as total_earned,
    min(available_at) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'pending') as next_available_at
  from public.wallet_ledger
  where user_id = p_user;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.years_propagate_course_move()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.course_id is distinct from old.course_id then
    update public.subjects set course_id = new.course_id
      where year_id = new.id and course_id is distinct from new.course_id;
    update public.products set course_id = new.course_id
      where scope = 'year' and year_id = new.id and course_id is distinct from new.course_id;
    -- chapters/notes/videos/quiz_tests follow transitively via the
    -- subjects_after_write cascade triggered by the update above.
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
